# MIFECO Affiliate Program

**Goal:** Launch a structured affiliate program to incentivize partners, content creators, and customers to refer new users to MIFECO’s AI and 3D printing services.

---

## 1. Commission Structure

| Tier | Commission Rate | Recurring? | Conditions |
|------|----------------|------------|------------|
| **Standard Affiliate** | 10% | Yes (recurring for 12 months) | Applies to all referred payments (subscriptions, one‑off projects) |
| **Performance Affiliate** | 12%
